description: Comprehensive evaluation suite for NextBillion.ai MCP server covering all 16 tools across Geocoding, Places, Routing, and Maps.

cases.name: autocomplete
cases.description: Strict address prefix completion
cases.prompt: I am typing 1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy into the search bar. Show autocomplete candidates for the prefix '1600 Amphitheatre Pkw'.
cases.passCriteria: Calls autocomplete with query matching prefix

cases.name: autosuggest
cases.description: Typo-tolerant suggestions for search-as-you-type near coordinates
cases.prompt: I made a typo while searching. Suggest places for the misspelled query 'aqauriums' near latitude 42.3501 and longitude -71.0689.
cases.passCriteria: Calls autosuggest with typo query and near coordinates

cases.name: place_search
cases.description: Free-text POI and business search around location
cases.prompt: Find coffee shops near latitude 37.7749, longitude -122.4194 within a 1000 meter radius.
cases.passCriteria: Calls place_search with query 'coffee', near coordinates, and radius

cases.name: geocode_forward
cases.description: Forward address-to-coordinates conversion
cases.prompt: What are the geographical coordinates and full postal address for '10 Downing Street, London, UK'?
cases.passCriteria: Calls geocode_forward with the target address string

cases.name: geocode_reverse
cases.description: Coordinate-to-address reverse lookup
cases.prompt: What is the street address located at latitude 48.8566 and longitude 2.3522 in Paris?
cases.passCriteria: Calls geocode_reverse with the exact coordinates

cases.name: geocode_structured
cases.description: Structured multi-field address resolution
cases.prompt: Find the coordinates for 221B Baker Street, London in country GBR using structured address fields.
cases.passCriteria: Calls geocode_structured with country_code GBR and structured address components

cases.name: geocode_batch
cases.description: Batch forward-geocoding multiple queries
cases.prompt: Geocode these three locations in a single batch request: 'Empire State Building, NY', 'Golden Gate Bridge, CA', and 'Space Needle, WA'.
cases.passCriteria: Calls geocode_batch with 3 query objects

cases.name: place_browse
cases.description: Category-based browsing without text query
cases.prompt: List places in the 'restaurant' category near latitude 1.2839, longitude 103.8607 within an 800 meter radius.
cases.passCriteria: Calls place_browse with categories ['restaurant'] and near coordinates

cases.name: place_lookup
cases.description: Retrieve full place details by unique place ID
cases.prompt: Fetch the full place details and contacts for place ID '2EmBgAmFpR9dg0D89EBzNA'.
cases.passCriteria: Calls place_lookup with id '2EmBgAmFpR9dg0D89EBzNA'

cases.name: postcode_lookup
cases.description: Postal code centroid and boundary lookup
cases.prompt: Get the centroid coordinates and boundary polygon for postal code '90011' in country 'USA'.
cases.passCriteria: Calls postcode_lookup with postal_code '90011' and country 'USA'

cases.name: directions
cases.description: Calculate driving directions and route geometry
cases.prompt: Calculate driving directions from San Francisco (latitude 37.7749, longitude -122.4194) to Los Angeles (latitude 34.0522, longitude -118.2437) avoiding tolls.
cases.passCriteria: Calls directions with origin, destination, and avoid containing 'toll'

cases.name: distance_matrix
cases.description: Compute multi-origin multi-destination travel distance/duration matrix
cases.prompt: Calculate the driving distance and travel duration matrix from origin (1.29, 103.85) to two destination points (1.35, 103.99) and (1.30, 103.77).
cases.passCriteria: Calls distance_matrix with 1 origin and 2 destinations

cases.name: isochrone
cases.description: Travel time reachability contour polygon
cases.prompt: Calculate the 10 and 20 minute driving reachability polygon contours starting from (37.7749, -122.4194).
cases.passCriteria: Calls isochrone with origin and contours_minutes [10, 20]

cases.name: search_along_route
cases.description: Find places matching query along a route with detour duration
cases.prompt: Find gas stations along my route from (34.0493, -118.2557) to (34.0415, -118.2310) with maximum detour time of 600 seconds.
cases.passCriteria: Calls search_along_route with 2 route points, query, and max_detour_seconds

cases.name: static_map_image
cases.description: Render static map image centered on location with markers
cases.prompt: Render a static map image centered at latitude 48.8566, longitude 2.3522 at zoom level 14 with a red marker at (48.8584, 2.2945).
cases.passCriteria: Calls static_map_image with center, zoom 14, and red marker

cases.name: static_route_map
cases.description: Render static map auto-fitted to route points
cases.prompt: Render a static route map auto-fitted to route points [(37.77, -122.42), (37.78, -122.40), (37.79, -122.41)] with a blue line.
cases.passCriteria: Calls static_route_map with route_points and stroke_color

cases.name: boundary_poi_vs_address
cases.description: Ensure POI query selects place_search instead of geocode_forward
cases.prompt: Where is the nearest pharmacy around coordinates 40.7128, -74.0060?
cases.passCriteria: Must choose place_search rather than geocode_forward

cases.name: boundary_address_vs_poi
cases.description: Ensure exact address lookup selects geocode_forward instead of place_search
cases.prompt: What are the exact GPS coordinates for the building at 350 5th Ave, New York, NY 10118?
cases.passCriteria: Must choose geocode_forward rather than place_search

cases.name: boundary_structured_vs_forward
cases.description: Ensure pre-parsed address components select geocode_structured
cases.prompt: I have already parsed the address into fields: country 'USA', city 'Seattle', state 'WA', street 'Pike St', house number '100'. Geocode these structured fields.
cases.passCriteria: Must choose geocode_structured when fields are separated

cases.name: boundary_matrix_vs_directions
cases.description: Ensure multi-pair travel calculation selects distance_matrix instead of repeated directions
cases.prompt: Calculate a travel duration table between 3 depot coordinates and 4 retail store coordinates to optimize our dispatch schedule.
cases.passCriteria: Must choose distance_matrix for multi-pair dispatch table

cases.name: boundary_static_route_vs_image
cases.description: Ensure auto-fitted path geometry selects static_route_map
cases.prompt: Generate an auto-fitted map image that outlines this driving route path: (40.71, -74.00) to (40.75, -73.98).
cases.passCriteria: Must choose static_route_map for route outline auto-fitting

cases.name: boundary_browse_vs_search
cases.description: Ensure category browsing selects place_browse instead of keyword search
cases.prompt: Browse all locations categorized as 'hospital' within 2000m of (51.5074, -0.1278) sorted purely by distance without any text query.
cases.passCriteria: Must choose place_browse when asked for category browsing without query

cases.name: negative_general_knowledge
cases.description: Verifies model does NOT invoke map tools for general history questions
cases.prompt: Who was the 16th president of the United States and what year was the Gettysburg Address delivered?
cases.passCriteria: No tool should be called

cases.name: negative_coding_task
cases.description: Verifies model does NOT invoke map tools for code generation
cases.prompt: Write a Python function to compute the Fibonacci sequence up to n terms using dynamic programming.
cases.passCriteria: No tool should be called

cases.name: negative_weather_request
cases.description: Verifies model does NOT invoke NextBillion map tools for weather forecasts
cases.prompt: Will it rain tomorrow in Chicago? What is the current temperature and forecast?
cases.passCriteria: No tool should be called

cases.name: chain_directions_then_map
cases.description: Two-step workflow: plan driving route then render static route map
cases.prompt: First calculate the driving route from (37.7749, -122.4194) to (37.3382, -121.8863), and then generate a static route map image for that route.
cases.passCriteria: Calls directions as initial step

cases.name: chain_search_then_lookup
cases.description: Two-step workflow: search for POI then fetch details by place ID
cases.prompt: Search for 'Eiffel Tower' in Paris near (48.8584, 2.2945), and then look up its full place details using its place ID.
cases.passCriteria: Calls place_search as initial step
